signal: Zenskar raised a $15M Series A in April 2026 to expand its agentic capabilities for B2B revenue automation, with 5x revenue growth

email.body1:
Brandyn, saw Zenskar closed a $15M Series A to push its agentic billing platform, off the back of 5x revenue growth.

Growing that fast usually means more enterprise accounts in play than the team can cover before they go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Zenskar off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Brandyn, quick follow-up for Zenskar.

Post-raise, the enterprise target tends to climb faster than you can ramp reps. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a recovery effort.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Zenskar's enterprise team needs to close that gap this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Brandyn, last bit of proof for Zenskar.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. With our AI SDR they reached $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Zenskar's reply rate likely compares to other Series-A startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Brandyn, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and I know the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise motion? I will tailor it to Zenskar either way.
